Names you can read out. Faces you can describe.

diurnal-bluecrab

a red pig wearing a black cap, on sand

Every account gets one adjective, one animal, and one creature drawn from a fixed vocabulary of parts. Because each part has a name, two people can confirm an account over the phone: “I see a red bear in a top hat on mint — same?”

48 of 4,194,304 names. Click to copy.

4,194,304 names and 49,536 distinct faces. Derived from independent parts of the same hash, so name plus face is about 37 bits to confirm — far past what two people mistype, though a face alone is only 1 in 49,536.

Data and code in this repo: animals.json, adjectives.json, sprites.json, avatar.ts, avatar.py, usernames.ts, usernames.py.
